name: Ethylene glycol dioleate
description: Ethylene glycol dioleate (CAS 928-24-5 ) is a diester of ethylene glycol and oleic acid used across industrial formulation as a lubricant, plasticizer, and surface modifier. It delivers controlled slip, softening, and wetting performance in demanding processing environments. In metalworking and industrial lubricants, it functions as a base component or additive that reduces friction and improves tool life in cutting and forming operations. This chemical provides essential lubricity for high-speed manufacturing. Textile processors use it as a fiber lubricant and softening agent, improving yarn handling and reducing breakage during spinning and weaving. It ensures consistent quality and durability throughout the entire textile production cycle. In plastics compounding, it acts as an internal plasticizer and processing aid, improving flexibility and melt flow in polymer formulations. This allows for more efficient extrusion and molding processes in various industrial settings. Leather and paper finishing operations apply it as a surface modifier to enhance suppleness, smoothness, and coating adhesion. These properties are vital for achieving the desired tactile and visual characteristics in finished goods. Ethylene glycol dioleate is supplied as a liquid at ambient conditions. Technical grade is the standard commercial offering, suitable for industrial lubricant, textile, and polymer applications across the global chemical market. Buyers should confirm acid value, ester content, and color specifications with suppliers. These parameters vary between production batches and directly affect performance in sensitive formulations and specialized industrial applications.
